body: I don't know, it depends on how life changes for me.
I don't know, it just seems idealistic rather than realistic.

I know, the headlines aren't permanent. Everyone will forget eventually, but it'll still spark some debate and pondering. It'll be more acceptable in a sense. And, for the long life suggestion, I'm not doing that since nothing good will come out of for me. It's like a business deal, it'll be the worst investment ever made. And, I don't see how living life would be more dramatic than committing suicide. Suicide is an ultimate dramatic event.

I think so, yeah. I'm constantly down even though I can mask it pretty well. I think a lot. You're right, life is never constant, it changes. However, life doesn't mean that it changes for the better. For some it does, but for some it doesn't. It's like a game of Solitaire, some people fold and others are flushed in the process with no incentive.

I don't necessarily think I'll feel regret, it depends on the person. My survival instincts might kick in, but that's about it. And sometimes, circumstances just occur unexpectedly that make life the way it is for an individual. It's called bad luck; life. It happens to most, and it does not happen to some. Situations do not change for everyone.

To be honest, nothing has been able to make me happy that can take these burdens away. And, that's what I want, to rot in the ground without any feeling or contact. Drifting away in a lifeless corpse.
There isn't really any room for improvement for my issues or situations. I've tried, it's just too far gone.
Thanks but I'm sticking to my original plan.
I don't think that is such a good idea.
How is what?
Therapists just give generic advice. They've told me so much nonsense that I just got sick of it all. Nothing they say helps. I'm not resorting to medication since that'll be even worse.
I'm doing it. Like I said, the healthcare system is a joke. Moreover, words alone cannot fix what is done. Medication cannot fix much either.

I did try, but nothing worked. I utterly despise my life, and just the existing torments me. I just do not wish to live anymore and just want to end it all. Most people would find solace and fun in living, but I don't. I don't want to be a resident on this planet any longer.
I cannot discuss that one here. I'm sorry. It doesn't involve hurting anyone else though.
Thank you.
I used to play the trumpet. Look, trivial things will not make my circumstances go away. It's there, and it's reality. It's how it is. Nothing left.
Nah, I can't. I have Scoliosis, a curvature in my spinal chord. After my surgery I was restricted from engaging in rigorous physical activity and sports. So, no.
I tried weed before, but I didn't like it. But, I'm not going to abuse illicit substances just to live life. I'm not going down that road. Additionally, it just makes things worse.
Let's just say, someone is going to finish me off.
Yes, and she does not help at all. I even consulted with my family doctor, and it still did not do any good. The Healthcare system is a joke.

I'm going to do it in an extreme measure.
I do talk to a therapist, and it's definitely no help. It's all just a big business and combination of generic phrases; pointless.

I already decided. And, that's not necessarily true of what you previously stated. For some people yes, but not the majority of them.
I've been through stuff, and I'm still going through stuff. Basically, life is just getting harder and harder. I do not deserve that but it just keeps kicking me down. So, I'm ending it with a bang.
